name: FourierPeakMask
label: Fourier Peak Mask
description: Keep only the reciprocal-space volumes around the given peaks and transform back to real space, the equivalent of selected-area electron diffraction. Run 'FFT (abs log)' on a copy of the data first, read off each peak's (x, y, z) voxel index, and enter the peaks below. Soft spherical windows (erf edges) are applied around each peak and, optionally, its Friedel mate mirrored through the spectrum center.

parameters.name: centers
parameters.label: Peak Centers
parameters.description: One peak per line (or semicolon-separated) as 'x, y, z' voxel indices into the centered spectrum, as shown by the 'FFT (abs log)' operator.

parameters.name: centers_file
parameters.label: Peak Centers CSV
parameters.description: Optional CSV file with one x,y,z row per peak. Header lines and extra columns are ignored. Used in addition to any peaks typed above.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.label: Window Radius (bins)
parameters.description: Radius of the spherical window around each peak, in frequency bins.

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.label: Edge Softness (bins)
parameters.description: Softness of the window edge (erf transition width), in frequency bins.

parameters.name: include_friedel_mates
parameters.label: Include Friedel Mates
parameters.description: Also keep each peak's mirror through the spectrum center. The spectrum of real data is symmetric, so this is almost always wanted; peaks whose own window already covers the center are not mirrored twice.
